podcast.body: As the year 1984 commenced, this song was lodged in the top three on the Hot 100 chart, demonstrating Duran Duran's continued success and their status as "chart conquerors in America." The track emerged from the "cauldron of 83" and solidified their role as "Video Demi Gods" during the second British invasion. "As the year began, the band's union of the snake was lodged in the top three on the Hot 100."
